adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null,` around lines ~1040). Later, for COLLECTIVE team events it does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`, which is a no-op when `destinationCalendar` is null, silently discarding `teamDestinationCalendars` collected from other hosts. This also interacts with `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, which only iterates destinations when `event.destinationCalendar && event.destinationCalendar.length > 0`; `null` falls into the fallback branch, so the multi-host destination calendars are not used. This matches the finding's described failure mode and is directly verifiable from the diff.
